name: Open Redirect
attack_scenario: the redirect target comes straight from user input, so an attacker crafts a link on the trusted site that bounces the victim to a phishing or token-stealing page
negative_test_hint: submit next = "https://evil.example/" and assert the redirect is refused or forced to a relative path

exemplar.explanation: only redirect to validated relative paths (or an allowlist of hosts), never a raw user-supplied URL
